verdict.rationale: Fly.io's docs say apps can be deployed to regions worldwide, with users reaching the nearest server over a global Anycast network [fly-io-docs-20]. Fly Machines are described as running close to users [fly-io-docs-14], multi-region deploys take a single command [fly-io-docs-25], and Docker images run globally [fly-io-docs-32]; one user reports a dramatic performance uplift [fly-io-comm-11]. Missing for 10: a concrete region list or count in the evidence, and independent hands-on confirmation of latency gains from edge placement specifically.
